TS023 no-compound-condition

A condition evaluates one boolean, because a compound condition hides which cases are handled; split it into nested branches.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: warning
default: on
group: stable

TigerStyle: "Compound conditions that evaluate multiple booleans make it difficult for the reader to verify that all cases are handled. Split compound conditions into simple conditions using nested `if/else` branches. Split complex `else if` chains into `else { if { } }` trees."
